title: [2026 Hardening] Consolidate the application entry points
objective: Define one documented application bootstrap path and remove or redirect competing entry points.

title: [2026 Hardening] Finish migration of runtime modules from JavaScript to TypeScript
objective: Migrate remaining runtime modules with strict types and no behavior regressions.

title: [2026 Hardening] Enforce type-checking as a required CI gate
objective: Run the TypeScript checker on every pull request and prevent merges when it fails.

title: [2026 Hardening] Stop tracking generated dist artifacts
objective: Produce distributable assets in CI or releases instead of storing generated bundles on the main branch.

title: [2026 Hardening] Standardize the repository on one Node package manager
objective: Choose and document one package manager so dependency resolution is deterministic.

title: [2026 Hardening] Add a supported Node version test matrix
objective: Test the minimum and current supported Node releases and publish the support policy.

title: [2026 Performance] Enforce route and vendor bundle budgets
objective: Fail CI when initial or lazy chunks exceed agreed compressed-size budgets.

title: [2026 Reliability] Add recovery UI for failed lazy route imports
objective: Recover gracefully when a code-split chunk cannot be downloaded after a deployment.

title: [2026 Reliability] Cancel stale Horizon requests during account changes
objective: Prevent slower responses for an old account or network from overwriting current state.

title: [2026 Reliability] Centralize Horizon retry, timeout, and backoff policy
objective: Apply bounded retries, explicit timeouts, and actionable errors consistently to Horizon calls.

title: [2026 Reliability] Make network switching atomic across dashboard state
objective: Clear or revalidate all network-scoped data before rendering the newly selected network.

title: [2026 Reliability] Add jitter and online-state awareness to ledger stream reconnects
objective: Avoid reconnect storms and pause retries while the browser is offline.

title: [2026 Data] Version IndexedDB schemas and test migrations
objective: Preserve user settings and cached data safely across schema upgrades.

title: [2026 Data] Handle browser storage quota exhaustion gracefully
objective: Detect quota errors, evict safe cache entries, and explain recovery options to users.

title: [2026 Data] Resolve concurrent cross-tab state updates deterministically
objective: Prevent lost updates when multiple tabs edit settings or connected-account state.

title: [2026 Stellar] Add SEP-0002 federation address resolution
objective: Resolve name*domain federation addresses with validation and explicit user confirmation.

title: [2026 Transactions] Validate memo requirements before submission
objective: Warn when a destination requires a memo and validate memo type and length client-side.

title: [2026 Transactions] Use decimal-safe stroop conversion everywhere
objective: Eliminate floating-point rounding from XLM and asset amount conversion.

title: [2026 Transactions] Add reusable time-bounds presets and expiration warnings
objective: Make safe transaction expiration the default and clearly display absolute expiry times.

title: [2026 Transactions] Support Stellar transaction preconditions
objective: Expose ledger bounds, sequence age, min sequence, and extra signer preconditions.

title: [2026 Transactions] Preview signer thresholds before wallet approval
objective: Explain which operations require which threshold and whether available signatures satisfy it.

title: [2026 Transactions] Complete fee-bump envelope signing support
objective: Build, inspect, sign, and export fee-bump transactions without losing inner-envelope details.

title: [2026 Wallet] Implement end-to-end Ledger transaction signing
objective: Send supported envelopes to Ledger devices and return verified signed XDR.

title: [2026 Wallet] Add wallet session revocation and account-change listeners
target: Freighter connector and global wallet state
objective: React safely when the extension locks, disconnects, changes account, or changes network.

title: [2026 Safety] Require an explicit Mainnet review step for writes
target: all transaction and contract submission flows
objective: Show network, source, destination, assets, fees, and irreversible actions before Mainnet signing.

title: [2026 Soroban] Parse contract specs into typed invocation forms
objective: Generate argument controls from contract spec entries instead of relying on manual type selection.

title: [2026 Soroban] Display complete simulation resource and fee estimates
objective: Show CPU, memory, ledger footprint, refundable fee, and minimum resource fee in understandable units.

title: [2026 Soroban] Poll submitted transactions to a terminal status
objective: Track pending Soroban transactions through success, failure, timeout, and expiration.

title: [2026 Soroban] Decode contract events using the contract spec
objective: Render event topics and values as typed, searchable data with raw XDR fallback.

title: [2026 Paths] Support both strict-send and strict-receive path payments
objective: Let users quote both path-payment modes and compare source amount, destination amount, and slippage.

title: [2026 DEX] Add price-impact and minimum-received safeguards
target: DEXExplorer, order book, and transaction builder
objective: Calculate price impact and enforce user-selected slippage protection before building trades.

title: [2026 Stellar] Add a claimable-balance lifecycle workspace
target: claimable balance components and Horizon helpers
objective: List, inspect, create, and claim balances with predicate explanations.

title: [2026 DEX] Surface liquidity-pool positions and withdrawal estimates
objective: Show pool shares, reserves, estimated underlying assets, and withdrawal impact.

title: [2026 Assets] Validate asset issuers and trustline authorization state
objective: Distinguish valid issuers, missing issuers, authorization-required assets, and clawback-enabled assets.

title: [2026 API] Add authenticated access for sensitive server routes
objective: Define authentication and authorization boundaries for routes that expose user-specific or operational data.

title: [2026 API] Back rate limiting with a shared production store
objective: Keep limits consistent across processes and instances while preserving useful retry headers.

title: [2026 Security] Ship a restrictive Content Security Policy
objective: Restrict scripts, connections, frames, and fonts while supporting required Stellar and wallet endpoints.

title: [2026 Security] Redact secrets and signed XDR from diagnostics
objective: Prevent secret keys, tokens, signed envelopes, and sensitive memos from reaching telemetry.

title: [2026 Privacy] Add explicit consent and data controls for Sentry
objective: Make diagnostics consent visible, revocable, and documented with a clear data-retention policy.

title: [2026 Accessibility] Audit keyboard navigation for all dashboard routes
target: dashboard components and Playwright accessibility tests
objective: Ensure every interactive flow works in logical order without a pointer.

title: [2026 Accessibility] Provide text alternatives for interactive charts
objective: Expose chart summaries and tabular data to screen readers and keyboard users.

title: [2026 Accessibility] Add a tested high-contrast theme
objective: Meet WCAG contrast requirements without losing status or chart distinctions.

title: [2026 i18n] Localize number, asset amount, and date formatting
objective: Use locale-aware formatting consistently while preserving exact ledger values.

title: [2026 PWA] Define offline read-only behavior for cached account data
target: service worker, storage, and network-aware components
objective: Clearly distinguish cached data from live data and disable unsafe write actions offline.

title: [2026 PWA] Add a controlled service-worker update prompt
objective: Let users activate new versions without stale-chunk crashes or unexpected reloads.

title: [2026 Mobile] Track web-to-mobile feature parity explicitly
target: mobile app and shared feature documentation
objective: Publish a tested parity matrix and identify which logic can be shared safely.

title: [2026 Testing] Add a deterministic Freighter browser mock
objective: Exercise connect, reject, sign, lock, account-change, and network-change flows in CI.

title: [2026 Testing] Build reusable Horizon and Soroban RPC fixtures
objective: Cover pagination, rate limits, malformed XDR, RPC failures, and protocol-version changes deterministically.

title: [2026 Testing] Add property-based tests for XDR and amount boundaries
objective: Verify round trips and rejection behavior across extreme amounts, memos, time bounds, and operation sets.

title: [2026 Documentation] Detect architecture documentation drift in CI
objective: Validate referenced paths, scripts, commands, and generated API documentation on every pull request.
